schema.text: When you walk or use a wheelchair, what do you usually do when the weather is bad (rain, wind, cold or great heat)?

options.text: Nothing changes, I travel as usual
It's less pleasant, but I travel the same way
I put off or skip some trips
I travel another way (e.g. by car or bus)

schema.help: Think about the parts of a journey you make along streets or pavements, on foot or using a wheelchair. If you do more than one of these, choose what you do most often.

en.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: When you walk or use a wheelchair, what do you usually do when the weather is bad (rain, wind, cold or great heat)?
en.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Nothing changes, I travel as usual
en.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: It's less pleasant, but I travel the same way
en.#I put off or skip some trips: I put off or skip some trips
en.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: I travel another way (e.g. by car or bus)
en.#Think about the parts of a journey you: Think about the parts of a journey you make along streets or pavements, on foot or using a wheelchair. If you do more than one of these, choose what you do most often.

it.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Quando ti sposti a piedi o in sedia a rotelle, cosa fai di solito quando il tempo è brutto (pioggia, vento, freddo o gran caldo)?
it.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Non cambia niente, mi sposto come sempre
it.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: È meno piacevole, ma mi sposto allo stesso modo
it.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: Mi sposto in un altro modo (ad es. in auto o autobus)
it.#Think about the parts of a journey you: Pensa ai tratti che percorri lungo la strada o sul marciapiede, a piedi o in carrozzina. Se fai più di una di queste cose, scegli quella che fai più spesso.
it.#I prepare differently (e.g. clothes, um: Mi preparo in modo diverso (ad es. vestiti, ombrello)

fr.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Lorsque vous marchez ou vous déplacez en fauteuil roulant, que faites-vous habituellement quand le temps est mauvais (pluie, vent, froid ou grande chaleur) ?
fr.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Rien ne change, je me déplace comme d'habitude
fr.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: C'est moins agréable, mais je me déplace de la même façon
fr.#I put off or skip some trips: Je reporte ou je saute certains trajets
fr.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: Je me déplace autrement (par ex. en voiture ou en bus)
fr.#Think about the parts of a journey you: Pensez aux parties du trajet que vous parcourez dans la rue ou sur le trottoir, à pied ou en fauteuil roulant. Si vous faites plusieurs de ces choses, choisissez celle que vous faites le plus souvent.
fr.#I prepare differently (e.g. clothes, um: Je m’équipe autrement (par exemple vêtements, parapluie)

de.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Was tun Sie beim Gehen oder Fahren im Rollstuhl normalerweise, wenn das Wetter schlecht ist (Regen, Wind, Kälte oder große Hitze)?
de.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Nichts ändert sich, ich bin wie gewohnt unterwegs
de.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: Es ist weniger angenehm, aber ich bin auf dieselbe Weise unterwegs
de.#I put off or skip some trips: Ich verschiebe oder streiche manche Wege
de.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: Ich nutze ein anderes Verkehrsmittel (z. B. Auto oder Bus)
de.#Think about the parts of a journey you: Denken Sie an die Wegabschnitte, die Sie auf Straßen oder Gehwegen zu Fuß oder im Rollstuhl zurücklegen. Wenn Sie mehrere dieser Dinge tun, wählen Sie das aus, was Sie am häufigsten tun.
de.#I prepare differently (e.g. clothes, um: Ich bereite mich anders vor (z. B. Kleidung, Regenschirm)

tr.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Yürürken veya tekerlekli sandalyeyle ilerlerken hava koşulları kötü olduğunda (yağmur, rüzgâr, soğuk veya aşırı sıcak) genellikle ne yaparsınız?
tr.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Hiçbir şey değişmez, her zamanki gibi yolculuk ederim
tr.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: Daha az keyifli ama aynı şekilde yolculuk ederim
tr.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: Başka bir şekilde giderim (örn. otomobille veya otobüsle)
tr.#Think about the parts of a journey you: Yolculuğunuzun sokaklarda veya kaldırımlarda yürüyerek ya da tekerlekli sandalyeyle yaptığınız bölümlerini düşünün. Bunlardan birden fazlasını yapıyorsanız en sık yaptığınızı seçin.

fa.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: هنگام پیاده‌روی یا حرکت با ویلچر، وقتی هوا بد است (باران، باد، سرما یا گرمای شدید) معمولاً چه می‌کنید؟
fa.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: چیزی تغییر نمی‌کند، مثل همیشه سفر می‌کنم
fa.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: کمتر دلپذیر است، اما به همان شکل سفر می‌کنم
fa.#I put off or skip some trips: بعضی سفرها را به تعویق می‌اندازم یا انجام نمی‌دهم
fa.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: با روش دیگری سفر می‌کنم (مثلاً با خودرو یا اتوبوس)
fa.#Think about the parts of a journey you: بخش‌هایی از سفر را در نظر بگیرید که در خیابان یا پیاده‌رو، پیاده یا با ویلچر طی می‌کنید. اگر بیش از یکی از این کارها را انجام می‌دهید، کاری را انتخاب کنید که بیشتر انجام می‌دهید.
fa.#I prepare differently (e.g. clothes, um: به شکل دیگری آماده می‌شوم (مثلاً لباس، چتر)

hu.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Gyaloglás vagy kerekesszékes közlekedés közben mit szokott tenni, ha rossz az idő (eső, szél, hideg vagy nagy hőség)?
hu.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: Más módon utazom (pl. autóval vagy busszal)
hu.#Think about the parts of a journey you: Gondoljon az utazás azon szakaszaira, amelyeket az utcán vagy a járdán gyalog vagy kerekesszékkel tesz meg. Ha ezek közül többet is tesz, válassza azt, amit a leggyakrabban tesz.

ar.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: عند المشي أو التنقل بكرسي متحرك، ما تصرّفك عادةً عندما يكون الطقس سيئًا (مطر أو رياح أو برد أو حرّ شديد)؟
ar.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: الأمر أقل متعة، لكنني أتنقل بالطريقة نفسها
ar.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: أتنقل بطريقة أخرى (مثلًا بالسيارة أو الحافلة)
ar.#Think about the parts of a journey you: فكّر في أجزاء الرحلة التي تقطعها في الشارع أو على الرصيف، مشيًا أو باستخدام كرسي متحرك. إذا كنت تفعل أكثر من أمر من هذه الأمور، فاختر ما تفعله غالبًا.
ar.#I prepare differently (e.g. clothes, um: أستعد بطريقة مختلفة (مثل الملابس أو المظلة)
